name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 27 times in 8 visits over 80 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 54 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2026-05-28, at wavelengths from 0.95 to 4.82 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
